rooms.1: View from a lower bunk in a small modern cruise-ship cabin: the underside of the top bunk overhead, a decorative ship's wheel hanging on the wood-panelled wall, a white carpeted floor, soft light from a porthole.
rooms.2: A small, tidy ship's cabin on a modern motor yacht: wood-panelled walls, a decorative ship's helm wheel mounted on the far wall, a round porthole with blue sky beyond, a ceiling fan, a bunk bed against the right wall with a ladder, a framed painting of a ship, a grey carpeted floor.
rooms.3: A wooden dock jutting into a blue sea under a bright sky with white clouds and gulls; a sleek white-and-tan motor cruiser with a red-trimmed cabin is moored alongside, two black mooring bollards on the dock.
rooms.4: View from the deck of a motor cruiser: a white railing in the foreground, the open blue sea beyond with small waves, a wooden dock just visible at the right edge, white clouds and gulls overhead.
rooms.5: A sandy beach by a small green hill on a tropical island, the sea on the left, clouds and gulls in a blue sky.
rooms.6: A narrow rocky ledge on the side of a sandstone cliff a few feet below a grassy hilltop, cracked tan rock face, sea and clouds beyond.
rooms.7: The top of a small grassy hill on a tropical island, a jumble of grey boulders on the right with a narrow dark crack between them, blue sky with a gull.
rooms.10: A tall, dark, weathered wooden stockade fence blocking the way, with a blank white warning board nailed to it (no writing), blue sky above.
rooms.11: The open sea seen from the water's surface: rolling blue waves to the horizon, white clouds and gulls in a bright sky.
rooms.12: Undersea: deep blue water with shafts of light, a dark rocky undersea slope, green seaweed swaying on a pale sandy bottom, small rising bubbles.
rooms.13: A dim smugglers' hold deep inside a ship: grey steel walls and deck, a rectangular pool of sea water sunk into the floor glinting with light, a very narrow dark crawlway opening in the right wall.
rooms.15: A rocky beach by the sea: tan and grey rocks along the shoreline, waves breaking, white clouds and gulls in a blue sky.
rooms.16: View from a top bunk in a ship's cabin: a wooden floor far below in perspective, wood-panelled walls, a round porthole high on the left wall.
rooms.17: Standing on top of a big red ship's diesel engine in a cramped engine room: pipes, a green control panel with gauges and warning stripes, red machinery all around.
rooms.18: A ship's engine room: a big red diesel engine with pipework, a green electrical cabinet with a round dial and a small grille, a gauge with a green face, white and grey bulkheads, a ladder up.
rooms.19: On a narrow catwalk along the outside of a ship's white hull beside a round porthole, a steel railing, the sea below, blue sky (no lettering on the hull).
rooms.20: A very narrow dark crawlway inside a ship, a square steel tunnel receding into blackness, faint blue light on its edges.
rooms.21: An empty ship's cargo hold: pale tan steel walls in perspective, a grey deck, a single bulkhead light.
rooms.22: Under a wooden dock, looking out from a beam just above the water: the open sea stretching away, waves, sunlit clouds beyond the dock's shadow.
rooms.23: A sunken wooden ship on the sea bed, its broken green-slimed hull and masts tilted, deep blue water, light from above, small fish.
rooms.24: Never Never Land: a magical green valley with rolling hills, giant red and tan spotted mushrooms, a winding blue river, a rainbow behind white clouds, tufts of grass.
